text: Justin Antheunis, President of International Alliance Theatrical Stage Employees (IATSE) Local 58 will be in attendance to provide a presentation generally about the relationship between IATSE Local 58 and the Board, and possible proactive approaches to be taken.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Requested the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place to: a. Include this item at the next Tenant Liaison Consultation meeting for further discussions with the tenants to work out suggestions for moving forward to foster better relations with IATSE Local 58 and stakeholders. b. Include consultation with IATSE Local 58 and all the other union locals at Exhibition Place as part of the development of the Exhibition Place Strategic Plan.
